name: TasTAFE fee payment plans and Centrepay
summary: TasTAFE students can pay fees weekly, fortnightly or monthly, or through Centrepay deductions from Centrelink payments.
who: TasTAFE students; Centrepay is for Centrelink recipients
how: Arrange a payment plan at enrolment; set up Centrepay with Centrelink first and match the TasTAFE plan to it.
catches: If you can't pay, contact a TasTAFE Student Counsellor to discuss your options.

evidence.quote: You can either pay fees in full at the time of enrolment or arrange a payment plan.
You may choose to pay your fees through Centrepay deductions.
If you are having trouble paying your fees, contact one of our Student Counsellors to discuss your options.
